newsitem.title: UK: NWE STRAIGHT-RUN FUEL OIL STEADY, RUSSIAN STRONG.
newsitem.headline: NWE STRAIGHT-RUN FUEL OIL STEADY, RUSSIAN STRONG.

text.p: European low sulphur straight-run prices were largely steady on Wednesday while high sulphur Russian material was holding to high ground after a strong trade late on Tuesday.
Traders said one seller was at $115 fob while a second seller was sticking to Tuesday's asking price of about $117.
"There's not that big of a difference in the crude price between yesterday and today," one trader said.
An independent trader that picked up a cargo at $110/$111 from a refiner on Tuesday was said to be reoffering it at $113 fob Sines, Portugal. The cargo loads August 16-20.
"It's loading a bit far away, so there's $1 or $2 extra freight, that's why they are asking $113 now," one trader said.
Russian high sulphur straight run was offered at premia of $5 to $7 to the two means quote. Traders said an E-4 cargo was picked up late on Tuesday by a refiner at about three means plus $3.50.
